3139|82bfeb72.name: Gar'Thok
3139|82bfeb72.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

784-progress.name: Gar'Thok
784-progress.text:
You have your orders, $N. The safety of Durotar is in question. Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.

Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.
784-progress.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

791-complete.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-complete.text:
Most excellent, $N. Any good $c will surely find a use for this bag on the battlefield.

I salute your vigor and willingness to die in the name of the Horde!
791-complete.title: Carry Your Weight

791-progress.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-progress.text:
I fought proudly alongside the Warchief when these lands were pioneered. The scars of battle mark my skin.

The honor of the Horde has been upheld with the help of my axe and battlecry during the defeat of Archimonde, when the unholy alliance was made with the humans and elves, wrought from necessity.

But my position as watchman and provider has given me a new sense of worth.
791-progress.title: Carry Your Weight

837-progress.name: Gar'Thok
837-progress.text: Though they do possess some intelligence and some organization, I find it constantly amazing that the quilboars were able to capture and hold so much territory in Kalimdor. Perhaps they are more crafty an enemy than I give them credit for...
837-progress.title: Encroachment

96604-progress.name: Brakk
96604-progress.text: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96604-progress.title: The Great Outdoors

96876-complete.name: Ukor
96876-complete.text: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
96876-complete.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

99048-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99048-accept.text:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048-accept.title: A Missing Hand

99048-complete.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99048-complete.text:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
99048-complete.title: A Missing Hand

99049-accept.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99049-accept.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049-accept.title: Threat from Below

99049-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99049-complete.text:
This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.

We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
99049-complete.title: Threat from Below

99051-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-accept.text:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051-accept.title: Threat from Below
